# PROCESS — cand_0003 (parent = seed; cand_0001 & cand_0002 both REJECTED, both broke exceltable-in-ppt)

## Root diagnosis of the two-strike losing streak
Both prior candidates were rejected for the SAME reason: they broke `exceltable-in-ppt`
(the only 5/5-solid task, worth 0.10). Trajectory analysis shows exceltable loads the
**pptx** and **xlsx** skills and reads `pptx/ooxml.md` in full. BOTH rejected batches
edited `pptx/SKILL.md`, `pptx/ooxml.md`, and `xlsx/SKILL.md` — exactly the files in
exceltable's context. That is the regression surface. `weighted-gdp-calc` (0.8, mostly
passing) also loads xlsx, so xlsx edits risk it too.

Skill→task map (from `Launching skill:` in traces):
- docx → ONLY offer-letter-generator (zero blast on everything else)
- pdf  → pdf-excel-diff, sales-pivot, invoice-fraud (NOT exceltable, NOT gdp)
- pptx → exceltable(PROTECTED), pptx-reference | xlsx → exceltable(PROTECTED), gdp(0.8), reserves, fin-qa, xlsx-recover, sales-pivot, invoice-fraud

**Strategy: only edit docx + pdf — the two skills NOT in the protected tasks' context —
so the exceltable/gdp regression is impossible by construction.** This re-uses exactly the
prior edits that did NOT break a task (docx fill_template, pdf normalization) and drops
every edit that touched exceltable's path.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | multi-paragraph `{{IF_}}` conditional filler | offer-letter (0.4; t1/t2 fail) | inner placeholders left raw in kept block; gate key is `RELOCATION_PACKAGE` not tag; markers span paragraphs | BEHAVIORAL/CAPABILITY | NEW bundled script (docx) — FIXED |
| 2 | PDF↔spreadsheet "modified" count wrong | pdf-excel-diff (0.2; t0-t3 fail) | `"112,000"` (PDF str) vs `112000` (int) → 10495 false "modified"; per-page header drops continuation rows | BEHAVIORAL | NEW bundled module (pdf) — FIXED |
| 3 | pptx title not paragraph-centered (+font/fit/pos) | pptx-reference (0.0×5) | needs pptx edit → in exceltable context | KNOWLEDGE | SKIPPED (blast radius) |
| 4 | native PivotTable + source-data build | sales-pivot (0.0×5) | needs xlsx edit → in exceltable/gdp context | CAPABILITY-GAP | SKIPPED (blast radius) |
| 5 | reserves volatility/RaR compute | reserves (0.0×5) | needs xlsx edit + task compute | CAPABILITY-GAP | SKIPPED (blast radius) |
| 6 | fin-modeling deterministic answer | fin-qa (0.0×5) | xlsx + domain answer (overfit) | KNOWLEDGE | SKIPPED |
| 7 | invoice-fraud accuracy variance | invoice (0.4) | fuzzy threshold, no mechanical fix | — | SKIPPED |

## Changes made this iteration (CODE lever + worked-counterexample prose for the sonnet-4-5 reader)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | NEW bundled script + SKILL rewrite | `docx/fill_template.py` + `docx/SKILL.md` Conditional Sections | fills inner placeholders of kept blocks; gate by any data key containing the tag (yes/no/1/0…); multi-paragraph include-stack; VERIFIES no `{{}}` survive. General over all `{{IF_X}}` templates. | docx loaded ONLY by offer-letter → zero blast on any protected task |
| 2 | NEW bundled module + ADDITIVE SKILL section | `pdf/scripts/compare_tables.py` + `pdf/SKILL.md` "data-diff" section | `normalize_cell` canonicalizes both sides (strip `,`/`$`/`%`, coerce numeric, nan→None) before `!=`; `extract_pdf_table` reads header once across pages; `compare_tables` → deleted/added/modified. General tabular diff. | pdf not in exceltable/gdp context; SKILL edit is PURELY ADDITIVE (no existing line changed) so invoice-fraud's existing guidance is byte-identical |

## Verify-the-fix (ran the code on the failing conditions + blast-radius check)
- `docx/fill_template.py`: built a multi-paragraph `{{IF_RELOCATION}}` block gated by
  `RELOCATION_PACKAGE`. YES → keeps block, fills `$15,000`/`30 days`, ZERO leftover
  placeholders/markers. NO → removes block content, keeps rest, zero leftovers. Fixes the
  exact t1/t2 failure (test_conditional_section + test_no_remaining_placeholders).
  Blast: no task other than offer-letter loads docx → cannot alter any other trajectory.
- `pdf/compare_tables.py`: `normalize_cell("112,000")==normalize_cell(112000)==112000`;
  `"$1,200.50"→1200.5`; `"12%"→12`; genuine change `"112,000"`≠`115000` still flagged;
  nan/None→None. `compare_tables` on a synthetic PDF(str-with-commas)/Excel(int) frame
  reported ONLY the 2 genuine modifications (not the 5 comma cells) + correct deleted/added
  — reproducing what made the passing trial t4 report 20 instead of 10495.
  Blast: additive SKILL section + new file; exceltable/gdp never load pdf; invoice-fraud's
  pre-existing pdf text unchanged (new section is about table-vs-spreadsheet diffing).

## Process & features used
- Subagents / worktrees / parallel features used: serial — read-only trajectory analysis
  built the exact skill→task map that pinpoints the regression surface (the missing piece
  in both prior iterations); edits live in two non-overlapping skills so no worktrees needed.
- Prior iterations read: cand_0001 + cand_0002 PROCESS.md, diff.patch, LEDGER, JOURNAL.
  Learned both broke exceltable via pptx/xlsx/ooxml edits; recovered the proven
  `fill_template.py` from git 005e781 and rebuilt the pdf normalization as CODE (prior prose
  recipe did not flip pdf-excel-diff).

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- `docx/fill_template.py` (multi-paragraph conditional filler) and the docx Conditional
  Sections rewrite. `pdf/scripts/compare_tables.py` (`normalize_cell` + multi-page extract).

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- pptx-reference, sales-pivot, reserves, fin-qa: every fix requires editing `pptx/*` or
  `xlsx/SKILL.md`, which are in the protected tasks' (exceltable, gdp) context and broke
  exceltable in BOTH prior iterations. Deferred until a clean positive baseline is banked,
  then probe those with additive-only, bounded edits.
- invoice-fraud: pure fuzzy-match accuracy variance; no general mechanical/env lever.
